notes: City of El Paso, TX (El Paso County), within city limits. Built by data/jurisidictions/run_elpaso.py (pacs_city.py + tx_pipeline.py). 205,661 parcels, $11.54B land.

Values: El Paso Central Appraisal District's 2026 certified export, 'As of Supplement' (exported 2026-10-13, PACS layout 8.0.34): certified values including supplemental corrections through October (each property's latest supplement). epcad.org is behind a browser challenge, so the export was downloaded by hand from epcad.org/OpenGovernment.

Geometry: the district's own web-map service (ElPasoCADWebService, BIS-hosted), joined on prop_id (217,959 of 218,259 polygons match). City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4824000; the City of El Paso taxing entity (CEP) agrees on all but 76 / 29 of ~214k accounts.

Classes are read through the district's state-code table: C2 = COLONIA lots (residential), C10 = commercial vacant lot, X21-X23 = ranch improvements on ag land (statewide D2), XV-C / XV-R = totally exempt. Exemptions: the roll's EX flags (EX-XV etc.) plus class X and named public owners: 7,194 records dropped.

Condo and common-interest developments (UND% / % INT IN COM AREA / UND 1/50 INT phrasings) merged onto their land: 1,397 units in 102 developments, mostly onto the unit hull grown into unparcelled ground (El Paso has few common-area parcels). 6 small units (~$0.76M; La Lorraine, Chaparral Park, one office condo) remain 4-6x their neighbours.

Land area: on 754 parcels the polygon is a fragment of the roll's own acreage (e.g. a 3.52-ac tract drawn as 2,359 sqft) and the appraiser's area is used; acreage repeated across a whole subdivision (a parent tract's 12.129 ac on every lot) is ignored. 18 GIS slivers carrying whole lots' values (Tierra del Este #90 lots drawn as 1-4 sqft), and 10 records whose polygon has no usable area (e.g. props 703947/703948, $507k land, which had shown as hex-only towers in the east), are hidden. One placeholder value (market == prop_id) taken from the district's map service.
Singularity sweep: 147 of 205,655 parcels, all genuine appraiser values, hidden slivers, or the 6 small condo units above.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified: 376 lots, 372.5 acres, $133.5M est. land value. apply_parking_category.py tagged 89 parcels 'Parking Lot'.

link: EPCAD's own property page, epcad.org/Search/Details/<prop_id>/2026 (pinned to the certified year these values come from; pattern from a working example, prop 108327). epcad.org is behind a browser challenge, so it is not checked from the build host.
